entities.name: Axali Doëseb
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Axali Doëseb was a Namibian music composer. He wrote and composed "Namibia, Land of the Brave", which has been the national anthem of the country since 1991. He also served as conductor of the Namibian National Symphony Orchestra.
